It analyzes temperature, rainfall, and surface changes to identify agricultural risks such as drought, heat stress, and water accumulation. The platform provides clear risk indicators and smart recommendations to help farmers make better decisions and manage resources efficiently.
summary:
MADAR is a smart agricultural platform that uses NASA POWER satellite data to analyze weather and climate conditions and help farmers make better agricultural decisions. The platform provides farm-specific climate insights, including temperature, rainfall, solar radiation, and other environmental factors that may affect crops.

By transforming space-based data into practical agricultural information, MADAR helps farmers understand changing environmental conditions, anticipate potential risks, and make more informed decisions about irrigation and crop management.

The project aims to bridge the gap between satellite data and everyday farming needs, making NASA data more accessible, understandable, and useful for farmers. From space to the field, MADAR supports smarter and more sustainable agriculture.
details:
Project Details – MADAR

MADAR is a smart agricultural web platform designed to connect NASA satellite data with practical farming needs.

The platform uses NASA POWER data to analyze local weather and climate conditions that may affect agricultural activities. Farmers can add and manage multiple farms, view climate information, track environmental conditions, and use the Field Advisor to better understand how weather factors may influence their crops.

MADAR focuses on transforming complex satellite data into accessible and useful information, helping farmers make more informed decisions about agricultural planning, irrigation, and managing weather-related challenges.

Benefits and Expected Impact:

  • Helps farmers understand local climate conditions.
  • Makes NASA satellite data more accessible to the agricultural community.
  • Supports better-informed farming decisions.
  • Encourages more efficient and sustainable agricultural practices.

Tools and Technologies:

  • NASA POWER API for satellite-based meteorological and solar data.
  • Replit for web development and testing.
  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the web platform.
  • Web-based technologies for displaying and organizing agricultural and climate information.

Innovation and Design Considerations:

The creative aspect of MADAR is turning space-based environmental data into a practical tool for everyday farmers. The platform was designed with simplicity, accessibility, and real agricultural needs in mind, considering different farm locations, changing weather conditions, and the importance of presenting information in a clear and understandable way.

MADAR aims to bridge the gap between space technology and agriculture, making satellite data useful beyond scientific research and bringing it closer to the people who need it most.
